# mooncake history

Inspect past mooncake runs

## Description

Without subcommands, prints the most recent run summary (equivalent to the previous `mooncake last`). Use `history list` to browse multiple recent runs and `history show <N>` to view a specific entry. Index is 1-based newest-first.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text or json |

## Subcommands

- [list](history_list.md) — List recent runs
- [show](history_show.md) — Show one historical run by index
